about: Number bindings of paper/tex/main.tex and si.tex, checked by paper/tex/build_ms.py gate G1. Each key is written in the text as \V{key}{value} (or \W{key}{word}). expr: a Python expression over the files below (JSON loaded; .jsonl as a list of objects), formatted by fmt and compared with the written value. doc: a phrase that must occur verbatim in a committed file (the frozen pre-registration, a frozen code constant, a literature journal in research/) and contain the written value (scale converts a percent in the text to a fraction in the phrase; from_phrase derives the value from the phrase's numbers n[0], n[1], ...).
